builder_claim: Governed local inference runtime with evidence, FCFS serialized scheduling, SSD cache persistence, model pool authority, tool proposal preflight bridge, cancellation safety, honest terminal outcome taxonomy, and X0-facing projection surface.
required_proof: All 9 mission tasks satisfied: evidence fail-closed, honest terminal outcomes, cancellation safety, FCFS scheduling proven, SSD cache hardened, pool authority enforced, tool bridge truthful, X0 projection released, hostile pass defeated.
observed_proof: 106 tests passing (pyright clean, ruff clean). 3-round prepublication review: 14 blocking findings found, 14 repaired. 8/9 attack domains defeated, 1/9 unproven (not material).

alternatives_rejected.reason: Deferred — requires external prefill + multi-request decode integration. FCFS serialized is the honest production capability.
Deferred to X0 Inference Studio integration milestone.
SSD cache is opt-in — off by default. Path safety and corruption recovery are enforced when enabled.

consumer_purpose: Governed, evidenced, cancellable, FCFS-scheduled, cache-persistent, model-pool-managed local inference runtime with tool proposal preflight for future X0 Inference Studio consumption.
implemented_capabilities: Fail-closed evidence emission — execution receipt failure prevents EXECUTED status
Honest terminal outcome taxonomy — EXECUTED, BLOCKED, REFUSED, CANCELLED, ERROR, RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE
Cancellation safety — cancel_signal Event stops engine threads; reset_cancel_signal enables reuse
FCFS serialized scheduling — queue ordering, concurrency, cancellation, failure, evidence reconstruction
SSD cache persistence — path safety, corruption recovery, content-light evidence, LRU eviction
Model pool authority — acquire/release tracking, active-generation guard, pending unloads, force shutdown
Tool proposal preflight — governance preflight through bridge; explicit statuses (refused, pending_review, admitted_pending_execution, refused_by_governance, pending_session_context)

X0 projection surface — 16-section typed dict projection with evidence health, terminal outcomes, queue/batch, cache, pool, bridge, tool, cancellation, privacy, governance, models, health, capabilities
capabilities_left_unimplemented: Full tool execution through ToolRuntime (requires X0 session context)
SSD cache enabled by default (opt-in only)
Desktop cockpit direct consumption (projection is dict, not wired to cockpit surface)
external_effects_not_executed: Google Drive upload (telemetry not in scope)
Real Apple Silicon execution (requires MLX hardware)
strongest_suspected_weakness: Pool resource leak on stream cancellation between acquire and try boundary was fixed (BLOCK-2, round 2). No known remaining resource leaks. Strongest surviving: RuntimeNotConfiguredError class was planned but not implemented — RefusalReason enum covers equivalent semantics.
proposed_reviewer_attack_surface: Evidence emission failure during concurrent cancellation races
SSD cache integrity after crash-during-fsync (not tested due to platform requirement)
Model pool pending_unloads set growth without bound (cleared on shutdown only)
stream_execute() evidence emission failure not visible to stream consumer (yielded but consumer may disconnect)
